relationships.subject: erenumab
relationships.evidence_quote: The numbers of MMD and MAMD decreased in all months, in both episodic and chronic migraine patients, compared to baseline (p < 0.001), while general well‐being (p < 0.001) and coping with pain (p < 0.001) also improved.

key_findings: In 100 real-world patients erenumab reduced monthly migraine days; 36% had >=50% reduction in >=3/6 months; constipation was common (65%).
